name: s1_forms_bench
description: A dataset for evaluating form/document understanding and field extraction from scanned or digital forms. It contains examples of forms where models must identify and extract relevant fields (e.g., names, dates, values) and possibly map layout/text to structured outputs. The benchmark is intended to test models' multimodal reasoning across visual layout and textual content.
reputation: A small, community-contributed Hugging Face dataset used for form-parsing experiments; limited widespread adoption.
